notes:
Round-1 fix (PKIX-m75.16) added #[must_use] to DeviationStore::active_at, active_for_lint, and expired_at in pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs (lines 551, 559, 573). All three return 'impl Iterator', which is already marked #[must_use] by the standard library. Clippy's 'double_must_use' lint fires on all three, and the pre-push checklist runs 'cargo clippy -- -D warnings', so this is a compile-blocking defect.

Fix: remove the bare #[must_use] attributes from those three methods. The Iterator return type already guarantees the warning; the explicit attribute is redundant noise that breaks -D warnings.
title: P2-RUSTY2: double_must_use on DeviationStore iterator methods
